intro: LockBit led ZCyberNews coverage across 59 ransomware articles from April 12 to August 18, 2026, with The Gentlemen and ShinyHunters also frequently named. The most cited vulnerability was CVE-2026-1731, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Reporting spanned healthcare, manufacturing, multiple, financial services, and government sectors, with incidents noted globally, in North America, Europe, the United States, and Turkey. Severity distribution included 43 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational ratings.
